clips.title: The story
paras: Off Darkshore, Gelkak Gyromast’s key lies in three pieces after threshadons sank his ship. Greymist murlocs took the middle fragment from the shore.

Gelkak Gyromast’s winding key broke when threshadons dragged his ship beneath the waves. The gnome pirate came ashore with his belongings shattered on the rocky shoals. The specialized key was made for his mechanical first mate, but the wreck split it into three pieces scattered along the strand. Coastal beasts carried off the top and bottom. Greymist murlocs prowling the Darkshore surf took the middle piece and kept it in their camps and among the wreckage they hold.
